steps: Run every canonical fixture journey in the approved isolated browser environment with the injected clock, IDs, storage, fixtures, and animation policy.
Capture browser console output and the complete network request log for each journey.
Intercept or monitor filesystem writes and record every write target relative to the fixture root.
Scan rendered output, logs, console output, and persisted state for credential-shaped strings.
Resolve every evidence link and verify resolution is limited to supplied fixture artifacts.
Record artifact and evidence versions for each run.
Repeat with a deliberately failing fixture or injected forbidden external request and capture the resulting deterministic failure record.
isolationProcedure.passCondition: Every journey completes with zero external requests, zero credential-shaped output, zero writes outside the fixture root, and evidence resolution limited to fixture artifacts; all logs and versions are retained.
isolationProcedure.failureEvidence: The deliberate failure must produce a reproducible record naming the journey, injected violation, expected condition, observed request/write/output, console and network captures, and a failing verdict.

required: C-01: accessibility-tree capture at both D-07 viewports with stable ID across re-render.
C-02: accessibility-tree link names and source-order capture.
C-03: keyboard, pointer, focus-only, and event-log browser traces.
C-07: color-independent structural and accessible-name evidence for all seven statuses.
C-09: reduced-motion and 200% zoom runs at both D-07 viewports with overflow and content checks.
C-14: rendered captures and accessibility names for all severity states.
C-15: two locale render captures plus malformed-date output and stored UTC value.
C-16: local artifact resolution captures and network logs for all four link outcomes.
C-17: recorded screen-reader walkthrough, separately from automation.
C-19: twenty-state current-build captures at both D-07 viewports plus owner fidelity acceptance.
C-20: end-to-end isolation console, network, write, and deliberate-failure records.
deterministicBrowserEvidence.blockedBy: No browser or end-to-end runs, visual captures, accessibility runs, screen-reader record, network/console capture, isolation scan, or owner/release-review artifacts currently exist.
